problem: Suppose that $5$ pictures are to be hung from left to right in a hallway. In how many possible ways can they be hung?
worked_solution:
There are $n=5$ pictures, so the number of possible arrangements is

$$
\begin{aligned}5! & =5\times 4\times 3\times 2\times 1 \\  & =120.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, there are $120$ ways of arranging the $5$ pictures.
